name: Artist Pulse
overview: Top Songs, ranked playback queues, and smart Singles/EPs for Jellyfin artist pages.
description: Artist Pulse adds private, local-first Top Songs and separate Singles/EPs to Jellyfin Web artist pages. It uses cached, rate-limited ListenBrainz popularity only when local listening history is sparse, and never displays a remote-only track.

versions.changelog: Server-wide Jellyfin Top Songs, resilient first-page rendering, native favourite controls, and immediate Show less.
Initial public release: local-first Top Songs, ranked queue playback, native favourite state, and Albums / Singles & EPs split.
